server.description: Identifier of the server where the message was sent.

message.description: The plain text of the chat message.

position.description: The player's position when the message was sent.

dimension.description: The dimension where the player was when they sent the message, e.g. minecraft:overworld.

main.description: One chat message per player. The record key is the server's signing key id.

description: Player chat message records for ATPcraft. Each message sent by a player is stored as a record in their PDS.
